RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Monday,  July 26, 2010/Sravana 4, 1932 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Coal; Corporate Affairs; Development of North Eastern Region;
Environment and Forests; Food Processing Industries; Information and
Broadcasting; Law and Justice; Mines; Minority Affairs; New and
Renewable Energy; Power; S tatistics and Programme
Implementation; Tribal Affairs;Women
and Child Development)
Total number of questions — 20
Differential treatment in
environmental clearances
*1. SHRI MANI SHANKAR AIYAR:
Will the Minister of ENVIRONMENT
AND FORESTS be pleased to state:
(a) whether, on environmental grounds,
a slum was dismantled at Yamuna Pushta
on the right bank of the river whereas
environmental clearance was granted for
constructing a permanent Commonwealth
Games Village on the left bank of the river
almost opposite the site where the slum on
the right bank was dismantled; and
(b) if so, the reasons for the differential
treatment of the two cases?
Reservation for minorities
†*2. SHRI SHREEGOPAL VYAS: Will
the Minister of MINORITY AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) the advice given by the Ministry on
efforts being made for unconstitutional
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
reservation in the name of minority
communities;
(b) whether the existing facilities being
given to the minority communities by
Government are not enough despite the fact
that there is no provision of reservation for
them; and
(c) the steps being taken by
Government in educating the minorities in
this regard?
Tapping of solar energy
*3. SHRIMATI T. RATNA BAI: Will
the Minister of NEW AND RENEWABLE
ENERGY be pleased to state:
(a) whether the States are tapping the
solar energy potential;
(b) if so, the details thereof during the
last three years, State-wise;
(c) the amount spent in this regard;
(d) the present status thereof; and
1

2
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
(e) how Government is using such solar
energy, State-wise?
Supply of sub-standard coal to
Satpura Thermal Power Plant
†*4. SHRI SATYA VRAT
CHATURVEDI: Will the Minister of
POWER be pleased to state:
(a) whether an instance of supplying
stones/substandard coal to the Satpura
Thermal Power Plant by the Western Coal-
fields Ltd. in May, 2010 has come to the
light;
(b) if so, the persons responsible
therefor;
(c) whether it is a fact that power
generation has fallen due to the inadequate
supply of coal to the plant; and
(d) if so, Government's reaction thereto?
Anganwadi Karyakartri Bima Y ojana
*5. SHRIMATI VIPLOVE THAKUR:
Will the Minister of WOMEN AND
CHILD DEVELOPMENT be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government has launched
'Anganwadi Karyakartri Bima Yojana', a
scheme for the welfare of Anganwadi
Workers;
(b) if so, the salient features thereof;
and
(c) the details of the persons registered
under this scheme so far, State-wise?
Setting up of merchant plants by
NTPC
*6. SHRI TARIQ ANWAR: Will the
Minister of POWER be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that NTPC
proposes to set up merchant plants, the
output from which will be sold in the open
market;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) Government's reaction in this
regard?
24 hour channel for Assam
*7. SHRI KUMAR DEEPAK DAS:
Will the Minister of INFORMATION
AND BROADCASTING be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government has any
proposal for 24 hour channel exclusively
for regional programmes of Assam in
Guwahati Doordarshan under D.D.
Network;
(b) if not, the reasons therefor;
(c) whether Government is aware that
the programme producers, directors,
technicians and artists of Assam are not
getting good opportunity to use their talent,
as the slots in NE channels are not
sufficient; and
(d) if so, the details of the action taken
in this regard?
Adherence to mining laws
*8. SHRI SANJAY RAUT: Will the
Minister of MINES be pleased to state:
(a) the number of existing companies/
Central Public Sector Undertakings
(CPSUs) granted mining lease/engaged in
mining of iron-ore and other minerals in the
country, State-wise, Company/CPSU-wise
and mineral-wise;
(b) whether these companies are
following the mining laws;

3
(c) if so, the details thereof; and
(d) if not, the corrective measures taken
by Government against the erring
companies?
Norms for auction of coal bearing
blocks
*9. SHRI PYARIMOHAN
MOHAPATRA: W ill the Minister of
COAL be pleased to state:
(a) the norms under which certain coal
bearing blocks have been proposed to be
reserved for auction;
(b) the number of such blocks, State-
wise, along with the estimated reserves of
coal therein;
(c) whether the proceeds of  such
auction would be made available fully to
the respective States; and
(d) if not, the reasons therefor?
Scholarship to minority girls
*10. PROF. ANIL KUMAR SAHANI:
Will the Minister of MINORITY AFFAIRS
be pleased to state:
(a) the number of girls belonging to
minority communities awarded scholarship
under the Maulana Azad National
Scholarship Scheme during the last three
years, State-wise; and
(b) the details of the measurs taken to
promote education amongst the
educationally backward minorities?
Adoption of orphans
*11. PROF. ALKA BALRAM
KSHATRIYA: Will the Min ister of
WOMEN AND CHILD
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether a large number of children
are languishing in orphanages across the
country and the delay in the legal process
of adoption is the main hurdle for their
adoption;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether the Ministry has urged the
Ministry of Law and Justice to speed up
the legal process of adoption; and
(d) if so, the reaction of that Ministry
in this regard?
Price of domestic coal
*12. SHRI MOHD. ALI KHAN: Will
the Minister of COAL be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government is considering
to bring the price of domestic coal at par
with the global rates;
(b) if so, the details and present position
thereof; and
(c) the views of experts and general
public in this regard?
Change in the location of power
project of GMDC
*13. SHRI KANJIBHAI PA TEL : Will
the Minister of COAL be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the Gujarat
Mineral Development Corporation Ltd.
(GMDC) has requested the Central
Government for the change of location of
power project based in Naini Coal Blocks,
Orissa;
(b) whether it is also a fact that in July,
2007, the Central Government has
originally selected GMDC to set up power
plant at Angul district in Orissa or Dumka
in Jharkhand; and
(c) if so, by when the request of GMDC
is likely to be considered?

4
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Amendments in wildlife related
statutes
*14. SHRI RAMA CHANDRA
KHUNTIA: Will the Minister of
ENVIRONMENT AND FORESTS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government proposes to
bring amendments in the wildlife related
statutes for providing statutory status to
the migratory corridors for mega fauna in
the country;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the details of Government's action
plan regarding the Sunabeda-Sitanadi-
Udanti tiger landscape?
Environmental clearance to Posco
Steel  Project
*15. SHRI D. RAJA: Will the Minister
of ENVIRONMENT AND FORESTS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the Orissa
Government had furnished wrong
information to the Ministry regarding the
forest land  acquired for the Posco Steel
Project, where hundreds of people had been
living for generations together, on the basis
of which environment clearance was given;
and
(b) if so, whether Government would
consider cancellation of environment
clearance given to the said project in view
of continuous protests from the local
people?
Criticism of judiciary by political
leaders
*16. PROF. P. J. KURIEN: Will the
Minister of LAW AND JUSTICE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government is aware of the
recent news reports about some political
leaders in Kerala severely criticising the
Judges and their judgements in the High
Court of Kerala;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether it is not the responsibility
of Government to protect the judiciary
from such malicious onslaught by political
leaders; and
(d) if so, the action Government
proposes to take in this regard?
Expansion of minority concentration
areas
*17. SHRI SABIR ALI: Will the
Minister of MINORITY AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether any requests have been
received for inclusion of more areas and
places under the minority concentration
areas;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the action being taken in the matter?
Delay in providing jobs to displaced
people of Balanda village
†*18. SHRI RUDRA NARAY AN
PANY: Will the Minister of COAL be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the work of
providing  jobs to several displaced people
of Balanda village situated in Talcher of
Orissa, is pending for years;
(b) if so, the details thereof and the
reasons therefor; and
(c) by when this work would be
completed?

5
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
National Tribal Policy
†*19. SHRI BALA V ANT ALIAS BAL
APTE : Will the Minister of TRIBAL
AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) when the draft National Tribal
Policy was prepared;
(b) the details of the individuals/
companies/partners who were consulted
during the process and the details of major
suggestions included in the draft;
(c) the reasons for the delay in
finalisation of the policy;
(d) whether there is any difficulty in
finalising  the policy;
(e) if so, the details thereof and the
remedial steps taken in this regard; and
N
EW DELHI; V . K. AGNIHOTRI,
The 20th July, 2010 Secretary-General.
Asadha 29, 1932 (Saka)
(f) the measures taken or proposed to
be taken for finalising the policy at the
earliest?
Captive coal blocks in NER
*20. SHRI BIRENDRA PRASAD
BAISHYA : Will the Minister of COAL be
pleased to state:
(a) the number of captive coal blocks
identified in the country, as on date including
the North Eastern Region (NER); and
(b) the number of blocks where mining/
production has started, State-wise in
NER?

I N D E X
(Ministry-wise)
Coal : 9, 12,13,18, 20,
Corporate Affairs :—
Development of North Eastern Region :—

Food Processing Industries :—

Mines :8 ,

New and Renewable Energy :3 ,
Power : 4, 6,
Statistics and Programme Implementation :—
Trbial Affairs : 19,
Women and Child Development : 5, 11.
